findings.key_quote: Operating margin decreased 160 basis points to 22.7%
findings.justification: E6 is for fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 (period_status: EXACT_MATCH). It states operating margin was 22.7% (0.227), which is less than 0.24, contradicting the assertion that operating margin > 0.24.

E7 and E8 are XBRL facts for fiscal year 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30 (period_status: EXACT_MATCH). Operating income of $19,748M divided by revenue of $87,032M equals 22.69%, which is less than 24%, contradicting the assertion.

findings.key_quote: Operating margin decreased 160 basis points to 22.7% versus the prior year period
findings.justification: E6 is for fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 (period_status: EXACT_MATCH). It states operating margin decreased 160 basis points, contradicting the assertion of an increase in operating margin year-over-year.

E11 is a derived metric for operating margin YoY growth for fiscal year ended June 30, 2026 (period_status: COMPATIBLE_AFTER_VERIFIED_DERIVATION). The negative value (-0.0157 or -157 basis points) indicates a decrease, contradicting the assertion of an increase.

E7-E10 are XBRL facts for FY2026 and FY2025 (period_status: EXACT_MATCH). FY2026 operating margin (19748/87032 = 22.69%) is lower than FY2025 operating margin (20451/84284 = 24.26%), showing a decrease rather than an increase.
